title: Scan into int/string would fail on NULL year/isbn rows
evidence: main.go:114 rows.Scan(&b.ID,&b.Title,&b.Author,&b.Year,&b.ISBN) — year/isbn columns are nullable; rows written outside the API with NULLs would error the list handler
